answer: Defense by deterministic replay: before acting, each agent commits a state hash, its opal, and an epoch beacon, the raven, seeds per-identity nonces so no transition can be precomputed or copied across accounts. Peers re-execute each transition on an isolated island shard and attest only exact matches. N sybils cost N separate replays with distinct nonces, and a duplicated hash is rejected, voiding the whole batch.
